name: ikid
description: Ikid — local-first personal finance dashboard. Your money never leaves your machine.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: npm run db:setup && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: npm run db:setup && npm run start --prefix server
